why: The control drawing itself from the CLICK instead of from the value the store accepted -- the same convention every Settings toggle beside it follows, and one `settings.ts` can genuinely refuse: `setQuality` drops an id outside QUALITY_PRESET_IDS, so a self-flipping label would advertise a preset that was never stored and keep advertising it until something else repainted. It looks correct in the ordinary case, which is exactly why it needs a test rather than a reviewer.
killedBy: hud: the quality toggle (issue #540) taps the toggle and reports the NEXT preset in the cycle, from a real click at the button
